name: Snehalata Prusty/ ସ୍ନେହଲତା ପୃଷ୍ଟି

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Snehalata Prusty writes poetry and novels in Odia. Her poetry collection Krushna was published by Paschima Publication in 2017. The Sahitya Akademi’s 2018–19 annual report also records her moderating a symposium session, offering a glimpse of her participation in literary discussion alongside her own writing.

In “ବନ୍ଧୁ”, her Kabita Live poem, the promise of a friend’s arrival sets a household in motion: lemons are gathered, food prepared and water placed for washing feet. The final preparation takes place within the speaker, who washes away anger, envy and resentment. Hospitality becomes an inward act of making room for another person.
